cover_letter:
Dear Brandon Locke,

I am writing to express my keen interest in the Webflow Expert Consultant role at The Brussels International Center (BIC). Your commitment to enhancing your public-facing platform and empowering your team to manage it effectively aligns well with my expertise in digital marketing, web optimization, and content management.

While my CV details extensive experience with WordPress and other web platforms, rather than Webflow specifically, I am confident that my comprehensive technical background and deep understanding of CMS structures, performance optimization, and SEO best practices are directly applicable to your needs. I have a proven track record of conducting thorough technical audits, identifying inefficiencies, and implementing solutions to improve site structure, content consistency, and overall search health. For example, I built and optimized mirook.com, implementing JSON-LD schema and running iterative technical SEO audits that measurably improved its search performance. My work on client sites like majistralecza.epis.to involved building and maintaining complex WordPress sites with consistent layouts for numerous member profiles, directly addressing challenges related to content organization and structural integrity.

My approach to your project would begin with a detailed site audit to pinpoint technical and design issues, inconsistent styling, and inefficient CMS collections. Following this, I would prioritize and implement a defined set of fixes, focusing on streamlining your CMS for simpler future content entry and improving core web vitals through image optimization and meta data best practices. For the training component, I would structure hands-on sessions covering editing existing pages, adding new content, managing media, and basic layout adjustments, designed to be practical and easy for non-technical staff to grasp. My goal would be to leave your team with the confidence and tools to manage day-to-day operations and a tailored reference guide.

I envision commencing this engagement in September 2026. As requested, I am prepared to propose a detailed fee structure (flat project fee or hourly rate) and timeline following a brief discussion to better understand BIC's specific priorities and adjust the scope if needed. I am available for a brief call to discuss this further. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
•	Extensive CMS Management & Site Building: Proven experience in building, maintaining, and optimizing websites, including complex structures with hundreds of member profiles and client sites, focusing on consistent layouts and efficient content workflows using WordPress.
•	Technical SEO & Site Audit Expertise: Skilled in conducting comprehensive technical SEO audits, identifying issues, and implementing solutions to enhance site performance, including structured data, image optimization, and page speed improvements, as demonstrated by measurably raising search health scores.
•	Content Optimization & Management: Adept at managing and optimizing website content, ensuring consistency, currency, and SEO best practices for organic growth across various platforms.
•	Web Technologies & Problem Solving: Strong technical background in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, complemented by experience in digital marketing, enabling a holistic approach to identifying and resolving website inconsistencies and technical challenges.
•	Analytics-Driven Performance Improvement: Proficient in using Google Analytics and Search Console to analyze site performance, identify areas for improvement, and report on measurable outcomes to drive organic traffic and user experience.
